column1: Rates effective October 1, 2026. Rates are variable and may change at any time after the account is opened.
Interest is compounded daily and credited monthly. The rate for the tier that your end-of-day balance falls into applies to your entire balance.
APY = Annual Percentage Yield. Fees may reduce earnings. A $5.00 monthly fee applies unless you keep a minimum daily balance of $1,000.
